R5D-moose-atv-0005.name: 380 m NE of Cedar Creek
R5D-moose-atv-0005.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R5D-moose-atv-0005.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Winkley Creek Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 13 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 7.9 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2007 (19 years old), 50 m SW: browse.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 5 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Moose in Region 5: check the LEH synopsis.

plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 77 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Soda Creek Townsite Rd, Hwy 97, Beaver Lake Rd, Likely Rd.
Park: 52.56405, -121.50086, where the truck road ends (Winkley Creek Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.0 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 380 m N, climb about 1 m.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-15, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
R5D-moose-atv-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-15: about 2,593 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.27 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 1 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
